counts: Executions summed across all vectors per incoming I state; debug/release and both I states agree. Static sites counted once per build.
caveat: Read-only observations and conditional per-site savings, not post-optimization measurements. Coalescing opportunities interact and are not additive; no frame reduction is forecast.

proof_obligations: exact A16 and home byte identity
no alternate entry or transient S change
IRQ/NMI restoration over extended live interval
new frame-object/parameter forwarding policy; exclude escaping, indexed, volatile and possibly aliased accesses

coalescing.note: Compatibility is not a committed layout or additive saving. Recheck every edge, A/N/Z, scratch and frame after recoloring.
